articles.title: Fitbit Edge is Google’s middle ground between Fitbit Air and Pixel Watch - TechCrunch
articles.description: Google’s newest wearable costs $179.99 and has a sleek feel like the Fitbit Air but with an OLED display.
articles.content:
Google’s Fitbit lineup expanded on Monday with the introduction of the Fitbit Edge, a new wearable that’s positioned between the Fitbit Air and Pixel Watch.
